newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends weaker after volatile day. [CORRECTED 17:25 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends weaker after volatile day. [CORRECTED 17:25 GMT]

text.p: ZURICH, Nov 1, Reuter - The Swiss franc ended weaker after a volatile day in which it fell to levels against the dollar that have not been seen in the last 21 months. It was sharply weaker vs the mark.

Dealers are somewhat puzzled by the volatility and sharp fall in the franc, but note the market is thin and even small orders are moving rates. Next week's U.S. elections are expected to quieten down trade, they added.

After the dollar rose as high as 1.2777 francs following the release of U.S. non-farm payrolls, it eased toward the close. * Dollar closes at 1.2725/2735 francs vs 1.2710/2720 and Thursday closer of 1.2580/2590.
Against the mark, however, the franc showed continued weakness, falling through support at 83.60 centimes per mark, but bouncing off the psychological level at 84.00 centimes.

Dealers, however, see further franc falls are now starting to eye 88.00 centimes per mark. * Mark closes at 83.92/95 centimes vs 83.56/59 opener and last night's closer of 83.12/15. (Corrects last night's closing figure)
* Benchmark three-month Eurofrancs 1.86/1.96 pct vs 1.75/1.88 percent at the opener.
